description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.skins object, which manages loading and registration of skins for the CKEditor rich text editor. It includes functions for adding skins, loading skin parts, and handling CSS/JS dependencies.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers a new skin definition with a given name and definition object.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a specific skin part (e.g., 'editor', 'dialog') for a given editor instance, handling dependencies and callbacks.
